svg.aria-label: Agent containment sandbox press: a press clamps three sealed sandbox cells, each ringed by its own lit isolation gasket — one Linux kernel per cell, a KVM hardware boundary instead of a shared-kernel container. The spin-up dial reads about 500 ms to acquire a sandbox; the audit gauge reads 96.1% — 5,969 of 6,211 Linux-CNA CVEs audited 1 Jun–4 Nov 2026 avoided, 4,375 fixed before public disclosure and 676 excluded by configuration.
svg.text: ≈500 ms spin-up · 5,969/6,211 CVEs avoided (96.1%) · 1 kernel per sandbox
